bio: Hi, I'm SUNAY— a passionate Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications and intuitive interfaces. I thrive at the intersection of design and engineering.
My journey started with pure curiosity — taking apart websites to see how they worked. That curiosity evolved into a craft I now practice daily, building products used by thousands.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open source, mentoring junior developers, or exploring the latest in AI and machine learning.
